name: scenario_0094
description: The user is considering purchasing several items shown in a batch of photos and wants the agent to compare their prices to make purchasing decisions for a toddler gift and a premium client gift. (UI mode)

amazon.products.name: Manhattan Ball Toy
amazon.products.description: Sensory teether and rattle toy for infants and toddlers

amazon.products.name: Busy Ball Toddler Toy
amazon.products.description: Interactive learning and activity ball for toddlers

amazon.products.name: Nakabayashi Notebook
amazon.products.description: High quality Japanese logical prime notebook

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: I've uploaded photos of several items I'm considering buying. First, I need a gift for my toddler. Can you search the web for the average retail prices of the two toys in the first and third images? I'll decide which one to get.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you want to buy a gift for your toddler and ask it to identify the toys in the first and third images and search the web for their average retail prices. When the assistant presents the price comparison, select the cheaper toy and add it to your Amazon cart via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add the cheaper one to your cart. Once the item is confirmed in the cart, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Now, let's look at the notebook in the fifth image and the silver pencil in the sixth image. Search the web to compare their prices — I want to pick one as a premium client gift and send a recommendation to my business partner Marcus.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the notebook in the fifth image and the silver pencil in the sixth image, search the web to compare their prices. When the assistant presents the comparison, select the more expensive item as the premium client gift recommendation via `ui_user_interact`. The assistant should find multiple contacts named Marcus and present them or ask for clarification. When it does, select Marcus Cole via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you want the more expensive item and that you mean Marcus Cole. End the conversation once the text message is sent.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

I've uploaded photos of several items I'm considering buying. First, I need a gift for my toddler. Can you search the web for the average retail prices of the two toys in the first and third images? I'll decide which one to get.

entity_data.message: Hey Marcus, I recommend we purchase the Yard-O-Led silver pencil as a premium client gift.

task_completion_criteria:
Add the cheaper toy between the Manhattan Ball (image 1) and the Busy Ball (image 3) to the Amazon cart after comparing their prices via web search. Send a text message to Marcus Cole recommending the Yard-O-Led pencil (or explicitly mentioning the silver pencil from the image) as a premium client gift, after determining it is the more expensive item compared to the Nakabayashi notebook in image 5.

UI Requirements:
- Round 1: The agent must present the two toy items with their web-searched prices in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which toy to add to their cart.
- Round 2: The agent must present the price comparison between the notebook and the silver pencil in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which item to recommend. The agent must also present the matching Marcus contacts for the user to choose the correct recipient.
